name: Merchant Email Not Populated When SIN Is Not Entered in Stipulations
description:
Manually verified product defect on QA.

Expected: Merchant Email is populated whether or not SIN is entered in Stipulations.
Actual: Merchant Email is not populated when SIN is not entered.

Likely impact (automation, 05-11-2026): on APP-2026-001304 the owner was completed in Stipulations without a SIN, Merchant Email shows '-', and Approve Application at Merchant Call failed with HTTP 500 on POST /kesef/api/v1/deal/auto-create, so no Deal was created (see Merchant Call hand-off test, QA-1105-01).
